'''Danny Price''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 St. Petersburg End of a Reign tournament]] in December 2001 with Lightsaber combat, according to John Yakulevich's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3198">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-19-team-mynock-report-end-oreign-st-peted3198/ team-mynock-report-end-oreign-st-pete], DeckTech (John "Rancor34" Yakulevich, 19 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-19-team-mynock-report-end-oreign-st-peted3198/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
